Get Flanders Heritage layers containing archaeological reports (archeologierapporten)

get_oe_archeologierapporten.Rd

`get_oe_archeologierapporten()` get an OGC Simple Features collection containing the initial reports of archeological excavation projects, submitted to Flanders Heritage within two months of the completion of fieldwork.

Usage

get_oe_archeologierapporten()

Value

An object of class sf (see st_read). The object has a comment containing the retrieval_time and retrieval_url.

Examples

get_oe_archeologierapporten()
